bill.title: Responsible Data Center Siting Act of 2026

action.description: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.

posted_text:
🏢 US HR 10321 — Data Centers Could Face New Environmental Rules

The Responsible Data Center Siting Act of 2026 would direct the Energy Secretary to create guidelines for where new data centers are built. The guidelines would consider how a data center affects the power grid, water supplies, local environments, nearby communities, and the local economy. The Secretary would also need to publish these best practices online and update them every two years. ...
